I visited this veterinary hospital with my cat, Storm, for basic grooming, based on my mother's recommendation: big mistake. The groomer was very aggressive with my cat--grabbing him by the scruff--despite my informing staff that my cat is not aggressive. I feel that your pet's comfort here is an afterthought at best and not a factor of consideration at worst.
I brought my cat for a nail trim to where she was very nervous and went into attack mode they handle her very well highly recommend

I had a very disappointing experience at O’Neal Vet in West Philly. The clinic was noticeably dirty, and my cat was mishandled aggressively during her visit. She was also misdiagnosed, which led to her developing ear mites, an issue that could have been prevented with proper care.

As a concerned pet owner, I was anxious and asked questions, but the two male attendants dismissed my concerns as overreacting rather than taking them seriously. Their behavior felt misogynistic and unprofessional, and they failed to complete a full examination of my cat.

This experience left me distressed and dissatisfied. I cannot, in good conscience, recommend O’Neal Vet to anyone who expects compassion, cleanliness, or competent care for their animals.
Was very good with Lionel and explained what was needed.  Will go back
I receive quality care at a reasonable price.

if you refer to your pet as your child...go to a different vet. littlejohn doesn't tolerate your anthropomorphizing nonsense. your appointment will probably not start on time. good doctors are never on time. if you think dust and dated finishes affect the quality of care your pet receives, you should go to art museum vets and help them pay off their designer flooring.
They took excellent care of my cat Frida.
This place does the best in regard to handling my , otherwise sweet, but extremely wild at the vet, cat. Professional. Thank you for everything.

You might look at the reviews and see vastly differing opinions about Dr. Littlejohn and his staff for either a 1 star or 5 star, and it might be a little worrisome but he has been a great vet for our cat Bongie.

Dr. Littlejohn is a little gruff but he really does love animals and is truly a kind person. If you treat him with respect and give him room to do his work, you can trust that he will treat and diagnose your pet well.

And to address the reviews, if all of the other patients that I see interacting with him and his staff left a review, it would be overwhelmingly 5 star with only kind words to say. Vet business is hard and often times not very rewarding, so to see such a longstanding business in WP with deep roots in the community is very inspiring to see.

I needed to take my cat to a new vet and they did an amazing job! This place isn't fancy, but they give high quality vet care!

My cat needed her annual visit and shots. The front desk was quick and helpful. The vet was professional and knowledgeable, and the prices are fair! I'll be back with my fur baby!

They leave dogs outside in any weather. I’m a neighbor, I see it all the time. It’s gotten to a point where I have to leave a review. If I was thinking of bringing my dog here, I would want to know.
Picture is from right now. It’s pouring rain, dog is left outside.
I called and left a message, no one has come out to check on the dog.

I’ve also seen dogs in freezing temps or left in full sun on a hot day.
Really concerning.

Awesome bedside manner

Old fashion vet,

Absolutely the best Animal Hospital around! My Toy Poodle, Lucy, gives them her highest recommendation—especially for their exceptional dental care. Whether you have a big or small furry family member, I encourage you to give them a try. Your pet—and your wallet—will thank you! 💰👍🏽. …

Lovely folks. Other reviewers are correct to say it's pretty no-frills, unless you count the embossed greyhound medallion on the front door, but they run a tight ship here. My cat was ill with... something tummy related. They treated her quickly, gave the firmest diagnosis possible and filled a quick prescription and I was on the way without any fuss. They seem knowledgeable, friendly, experienced, and no-nonsense. Refreshing in a vet. I'll be coming back for sure, but hopefully not soon.

Pretty sure I got charges for things that didn’t take place. I have a dentistry charge and all he did was glance at one side of my pups teeth and my pups not a biter and didn’t get aggressive with them one time and got man handled and muzzled. I literally had a good day until stepping into this dump filled with miserable old people still working..

Awful experience - do not bring your pets here under any circumstances. He immediately scruffed my cat just to weigh him, and when I asked him to not hold my cat like that he got very defensive, started addressing me with an attitude, and told him that I was telling him how to do his job. I tried to explain to him that my cat doesn’t like being held like that and that I have vet med experience where we prioritize making the environment fear free and so I like that approach with my cat. I left before we even did anything for the appointment, and when I tried to explain what happened that was upsetting he talked over me and said “there’s the door”. Awful and would never ever recommend to anyone.
The staff there are great me and my wife have taking our dogs to Dr Littlejohn and Pete for years and I can't leave out Annie.  Highly Highly recommend this veterinary.
